name: kookr-toolkit
description: Curated skills and subagents for AI-assisted development. 73 skills and 25 subagents for TypeScript, async, error handling, DI, DDD, TDD, git hygiene, OSS contribution, reviewer distillation, iterative RFC review, communication-quality paper review, and product-onboarding assessment (product-owner + user-test-simulator).

groups.label: Engineering Patterns
groups.description: Language, runtime, and architecture craft: types, async, DI, DDD, errors, logging, refactoring, state machines, messaging, git hygiene.

groups.label: Testing
groups.description: Test strategy and authoring: TDD, unit/integration, Playwright, agent E2E.

groups.label: Design & Analysis
groups.description: RFC drafting/critique, multi-agent analysis, and system/architecture modeling.

groups.label: Code Review
groups.description: Reviewing changes and preparing/triaging pull requests.

groups.label: OSS Contribution
groups.description: Contributing to external open-source repos: fork lifecycle, OSS PR lesson loop, GitHub issue/label/trending workflows.

groups.label: Codex PR Lessons
groups.description: Phases of the codex-pr-lessons learning playbook.

groups.label: Reviewer Distillation
groups.description: Phases of the reviewer-distillation experiment loop.

groups.label: Claude Code
groups.description: Claude Code internals: hooks, permissions, metrics, playbook authoring, notebook reuse.

groups.label: Agent Automation
groups.description: Designing and running autonomous agent workflows and merge/review loops.

groups.label: Communication
groups.description: Writing and explaining: findings, technical prose, paper review.

groups.label: Meta & Workflow
groups.description: Agent self-improvement and workflow meta: reflection, placement, token economy, UI mockups.
